    The Sharper Image® Motorized CD Power Tower 100

    Item No. SI-CD100 • Original Retail: $169.95

    The Sharper Image flagship motorized carousel in smoked acrylic and brushed titanium finish. $169.95

    ⚙️ Mechanical Architecture

    • • Continuous twin neoprene toothed drive belts
    • • Dual upper drive sprockets with lower idler tensioner
    • • Reversible 12V DC high-torque servo motor
    • • Automatic jewel-case fanning hinge at the top apex
    • • 40 to 100 jewel-case capacity with quick-latch slots

    💡 Electronic Features

    • • Overhead halogen viewing lamp illuminates CD spines
    • • Dual-speed motor (1x Precision Jog & 3.5x Turbo Scan)
    • • Momentary touch buttons or continuous rotary run
    • • Optical alignment indexer for single-CD ejection
    • • AC Adapter (120V to 12V DC) or optional D-cell battery pack
